title: What they said at the time

clips.q: John Antioco was struggling not to laugh.
clips.who: **Marc Randolph**, Netflix co-founder, on the September 2000 meeting, in That Will Never Work, excerpted in Vanity Fair, 2019[^18]

clips.q: The dot-com hysteria is completely overblown.
clips.who: **John Antioco**, as recalled by Marc Randolph[^18]

clips.q: We are determined, however, to gain appropriate market share in the online rental subscription business, regardless of the expected negative short-term impact on our operating results.
Blockbuster is a world class brand that I believe has great potential for future success.
clips.who: **John Antioco**, on the day he lost his board seat, May 11, 2005[^15]

clips.q: When my assistant came into my office in early 2005 and told me that Carl Icahn was on the phone, it was a complete surprise.
These factors raise substantial doubt about our ability to continue as a going concern.

The recapitalized Blockbuster will move forward better able to leverage its strong strategic position, including a well-established brand name, an exceptional library of more than 125,000 titles, and our position as the only operator that provides access across multiple delivery channels – stores, kiosks, by-mail and digital.
Dish Network’s retreat will render Blockbuster’s once-ubiquitous brand nearly extinct.
We’ll take a little crazy if it means keeping the store open.
clips.who: **Sandi Harding**, manager of the Bend store, to The Bulletin, as quoted by the Associated Press, March 2021[^30]
